'''Sea of Flames''' is an area of [[Port City of Guixu]], [[Huanglong]]. 

When [[Resonator]]s enter the Sea of Flames, they become eroded by the Incinero Petal pollens, causing a steady decline in their [[HP]]. This effect will gradually disappear within seconds after the exposure stops. Completing the [[Exploration Quest]] [[We Promise, We Deliver]] will permanently remove this effect from the area.
